texts.zh: 在我们探索繁星之前我们需要先拓宽视野。幸好，我们有一张复杂的星系地图可用。要打开星系地图，你可以按M键或是屏幕底部的星系按钮。之后就可以按Esc或是右上角的按钮关闭情报日志了。
texts.en: Before we can explore the stars we need to broaden our view. Thankfully, we have a sophisticated Galaxy Map at our disposal. To access the Galaxy Map, you can either press M or the Galaxy Button at the bottom of your screen. Afterwards feel free to close the Situation Log by either pressing Esc or the button in the top right.
